items.q: I never will forget that the that Martin Black because there was a time in my life I had the thing going

ctx.x: At the Savoy Ballroom. It happened the same night that Mr. Benny Goodman was playing at Carnegie Hall, doing his jazz concert, because Zutty, Gene Krupa, came up at the battle. Meanwhile I went down with the Basie rhythm section to play with Benny at Carnegie Hall, but Walter Page, Freddie, and Basie played in the Benny band. I did not. And Buck played.
